Order No.04 Dated- 20.01.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Pakur SC/ST P.S. Case No.03 of 2020 (S.T. No. 135 of 2022) for which cognizance has been taken under sections 376/511/504/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Pakur SC/ST P.S. Case No.03 of 2020
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
The Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier the prayer for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail was rejected as not maintainable as the offences punishable under Sections 3 (1) (s)
of the Schedule Castes and Schedule Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 was involved in this case.

entities.text: Schedule Castes and Schedule Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is next submitted that vide order dated 18.07.2022 passed in Cr.M.P. No.481 of 2021, the cognizance order under Section 3 (1) (s) of the Schedule Castes and Schedule Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 has been set aside and the only offence punishable in this case is under Sections 376/511/504/506 of Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Schedule Castes and Schedule Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is further submitted by drawing attention of this Court to Annexure-2 which is the copy of the petition of R.E.R. Case No.35 of 2018-19 filed with a prayer for eviction of the petitioner from the tractor showroom run by the petitioner and the said Madhumala Devi is the witness no.1 of the complaint basing upon which F.I.R. of this case has been registered.

It is next submitted that the said Madhumala Devi also earlier instituted a case being Pakur (T) P.S. Case No.201 of 2019 and the informant-complainant being a professional litigant have instituted several cases against innocent persons for money.

It is then submitted that the Narayan Prasad @ Narayan Bhagat vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ... ... on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142114531/
1 informant also instituted Pakur (T) P.S. Case No.16 of 2016 for the offence punishable under Sections 354 of Indian Penal Code against one Rajan Ray and in this respect, learned counsel for the petitioner draws the attention of this Court to Annexure-3 at page no.32 of the brief.

entities.text: Narayan Prasad @ Narayan Bhagat vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that this false case has been foisted against the petitioner only to pressurize the petitioner to vacate the tractor showroom.
It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false.
It is then submitted that the petitioner undertakes to cooperate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl. P.P. opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am of the opinion that it is a fit case where the above named petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Hence, in the event of his arrest or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned D.J.-1st, Pakur, in connection with Pakur SC/ST P.S. Case No.03 of 2020 (S.T. No. 135 of 2022) with the condition that the petitioner will cooperate with the investigation of the case and appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will furnish his mobile number and a copy of his Aadhar Card in the court below with the undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr.
